persos.desc: man in his 30s, aubergine-and-amber polo shirt, neat haircut, a plastic bag of tomatoes in one hand
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left, holding the bag, embarrassed smile

dialogue: Mon frère, pourquoi tu achètes toujours chez la petite-là ?
Ses tomates sont plus fraîches, Tantie.
Ce sont mes tomates dêh. Elle les a achetées chez moi ce matin.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The seller asks, arms crossed, her face turned three-quarters to the camera. The man lifts his bag slightly and answers with an embarrassed smile. The seller points at his bag of tomatoes and says the last line, her face clearly visible.
chute: The man's embarrassed smile freezes as he slowly looks down at his bag. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the embarrassed man's busted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LA PETITE QUAND ELLE VA LE REVOIR :
mecanisme: démenti par la concurrente à double cible : l'excuse du client trahit qu'il vient pour la jeune vendeuse, qui revend en plus les tomates de sa voisine
